teaching-cutouts.generationPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE source sprite atlas for grade-one English colour and object recognition. True transparent RGBA background, portrait aspect 4:5. Exactly four equal columns by five equal rows of square cells, a regular invisible grid. In every occupied cell center ONE completely isolated asset, at least 13% transparent padding on all sides, no overlap, no floor shadows, no labels, text, lettering, numbers, logo, watermark, colored cells or visible grid lines. The bottom-right cell is entirely transparent and empty. Render each row in this exact left-to-right order. Row 1: solid vivid orange cat with whiskers and tail; single golden-yellow simple miniature house with pitched roof, door and windows; vivid yellow open rectangular cardboard box clearly showing its opening and folds, no roof or windows; blue single sharpened pencil. Row 2: red single sharpened pencil; blue closed simple book; bright lemon-yellow cat, same silhouette and pose as orange cat; black cat, same silhouette and pose. Row 3: blue single bird facing right with beak and wings; red closed simple book; red round ball; green closed simple book. Row 4: green round ball; distinctly blue cat, same silhouette and pose as orange cat; one black monkey with long tail; ONE long-tailed monkey with distinct separate red, blue, white, yellow and black patches, identical pose to the black monkey, not five monkeys. Row 5: nearly closed deep pine green curtain pair with a narrow empty gap, no animal; isolated half-open apricot cardboard lid in three-quarter view, no box contents; plain cream diamond kite with long tail, only one kite; leave empty. Compare objects of the same kind at same scale, pose, linework and view. The stated colour covers most of each object, no secondary competing hue, especially keep true orange visually distinct from lemon yellow. Fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean paper-cut silhouettes, warm cream and deep pine-green ambience with restrained apricot accents, original picture-book assets, read clearly at 45 pixels. No written instructions in the picture. The cells will be cropped and verified individually.

quiz-cutouts.generationPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Make ONE separate sprite atlas of original quiz options for six-year-olds. True transparent RGBA background, portrait 4:5, strictly four equal columns by five equal rows of square cells. In each occupied cell, center exactly one complete object, at least 13 percent transparent margin on all sides, isolated with no overlap or other scene. The last three cells of row five are entirely empty transparent. No cell boxes, background tint, visible grid, text, lettering, numbers, labels, logos or watermark. Exact left-to-right sequence. Row 1: a white cat with distinct triangular ears and long cat whiskers; a white small dog with floppy ears, broader muzzle and no cat whiskers; a black small dog of the same breed and pose as the white dog; an orange diamond paper kite with a long ribbon tail. Row 2: an orange open rectangular cardboard box with obvious opening and flaps; a lemon-yellow diamond paper kite, same shape and scale as orange kite; a green open rectangular box, same shape and scale as orange box; a blue miniature house with pitched roof, door and windows. Row 3: a green miniature house, same shape and scale as blue house; a green closed book with unmarked cover; a yellow closed book, same shape and scale; one yellow sharpened pencil. Row 4: one red bird facing right with visible beak and wing; one white bird of identical shape and pose; a blue diamond paper kite with tail; one blue round ball. Row 5: a green diamond paper kite with tail, then three wholly transparent empty cells. State colour covers most of each object. Distinguish orange, red and lemon yellow with clearly different hues; render white objects true white with sparse dark outlines. Use the same silhouette and viewpoint across each color variant, with generous crop margins and no clues to correctness. Fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper edges, restrained warm cream and pine-green art direction. The objects must remain identifiable at small size. No decorative drawings or written instructions anywhere.
